git_scope: A depth-1 fetch of the pinned commit, which Mohsen Khalili and Sara Gharabaghi's k2m5-family release (jlevy/squares#973, packet moh63-dev-k2m5-family-2026-11-13) names for Evan Daniel's checkers zmx2 and qx2_zm.py. The scope is the files those checkers build or import with, and the licence and credits. Every file but search/zeromargin.py, LICENSE and CREDITS.md is byte-identical to a copy earlier packets retain and is pinned to it; search/zeromargin.py (SHA-256 3cb95fb74ce44666654d6cc193c3f255bd07ba6c9afd864a6f93e364d428c5cc), which the source's qx2_zm.py run imported and no earlier packet holds, is retained. It differs from the 640fe453 copy earlier packets keep by two added guards: an int64 bound that disables CHAIN totals that could overflow, and assertions that the pitch divides cy_max and is at most 1/2. Nothing in the tree was executed in the repository.

claims: No claim of its own: the checker files at the commit the k2m5-family release pins. zmx2 (verify2/src/bin/zmx2.rs, e2bb84e9) is Daniel's interval-certified mixed-cover checker in outward-rounded binary64 with exact integer mass tests; qx2_zm.py (6294052a) is his exact-rational checker for covers with a Lebesgue polygon, importing zm_mixed.py (1fd20346), zeromargin.py (3cb95fb7) and mixed_cover.py (bb89de15).
